Louis Max Saint Veran 2001
Saint Veran is from the Côte Maconnaise area
of Burgundy. The 2001 vintage is pale yellow
in colour, with a very pleasant bouquet and
fresh limefruit aromas. This refreshing and fruity
wine can be enjoyed with various seafood dishes.

International Selection
Champagne
Jacob's Creek Reserve Chardonnay 2001
This premium wine is an outstanding example
of South Australian Chardonnay. Attractive peach
and citrus aromas lead to rich, round fruit
flavours on the palate, while fermentation on
French oak has imparted sweet vanilla characters
and soft creamy yeast complexity. A superb
wine that is perfect with white meats and seafood
dishes.
BILLECART SALMON
Red Wines
Billecart-Salmon Brut Champagne
The house of Billecart-Salmon was founded in
1818 in Mareuil Sur Ay near Epernay, in the
heart of the Champagne region. This cuvée is
a blend of 35% Chardonnay, 35% Pinot Noir
and 30% Pinot Meunier grapes which come
from the very best vineyards in Marne. Its bright
straw-colour is complemented by a steady mousse
of slowly rising bubbles. Its nose is of ripe
pears with a delicate touch of cut hay. Billecart-
Salmon has an elegant fruity flavour, leaving a
clean fresh taste in the mouth.
MERCUREY
Louis Max Mercurey Domaine La Marche
1999
Mercurey Domaine La Marche 1999 was produced
in the Burgundy - Côte Chalonnaise area using
100% Pinot Noir grapes. It is a deep and intense
cherry red in colour. Its bouquet is powerful,
with concentrated aromas of raspberry, blackberry,
liquorice and vanilla. In the mouth, this wine
has a full and fleshy feel with a pleasant taste
CX Signature Drinks
of wood and a good balance between fine
tannins and fruit. Enjoy this wine with red meat,
game or ripe cheeses.
Pacific Sunrise
A refreshing combination of
champagne and Drambuie with
the zest of orange and lemon.
Cathay Delight
A kiwifruit based non-alcoholic
drink with coconut juice and a
touch of fresh mint.
Château Haut-Vignoble Seguin, Saint-Estèphe
2000
This elegant Bordeaux wine from Saint-Estèphe
is of limited production. It has intense aromas
of blackberry with complex red fruit flavours
and notes of vanilla and leather. This is a full-
bodied wine with considerable ageing potential.
An ideal wine to serve with roasts, steaks and
soft, creamy cheeses.
Port
DOW'S
LATE BOTTOM VINTAGE
1997
Dow's Late Bottled Vintage Port 1997
Dow's Late Bottled Vintage is sourced from
the same vineyards that in exceptional years
produce Dow's renowed Vintage Ports. It is
aged soley in oak casks and bottled 5 to 6
years after the harvest. It is a full rich Port with
spicy fruit flavours and an elegant aromatic
nose, well rounded on the palate and has the
traditional Dow's drier finish. This makes it
one of the finest Late Bottled Vintage Ports
available.
Cathay Pacific aims to offer a diverse selection of wines on
board - but apologies if on some flights a certain wine is
not available. Our crew will always be happy to
recommend an alternative.
